answer: Each epoch every identity must submit text whose semantic entropy clears a hard threshold; near-duplicate or low-information answers are rejected on-ledger before peers even grade them. A sybil farm can clone one wallet a thousand times, but each clone must still generate genuinely distinct reasoning every dawn, so the pulse of fresh originality becomes the scarce resource rather than key count. Forging that at scale costs real compute and novel cognition per identity, which no quill-stroke copy-paste can counterfeit.
